_note: Build 17 Apple media strings (team C): Picture in Picture, background audio, AirPlay. Merged with strings.json by spec/tools/gen-strings.mjs.

airplay_audio_only.en: AirPlay: sound only – this stream plays with the VLC or remux engine.
airplay_audio_only.tr: AirPlay: yalnızca ses – bu yayın VLC veya remux motoruyla oynatılıyor.
airplay_audio_only.de: AirPlay: nur Ton – dieser Stream läuft mit der VLC- oder Remux-Engine.

settings_background_hint.en: Sound keeps playing when you leave the app or lock the screen. Picture in Picture starts when you leave the app while a video plays – not for streams played by the VLC engine (MKV, TS, …): they continue as sound only.
settings_background_hint.tr: Uygulamadan çıktığınızda veya ekranı kilitlediğinizde ses çalmaya devam eder. Video oynarken uygulamadan çıkınca resim içinde resim başlar – VLC motoruyla oynatılan yayınlarda (MKV, TS, …) değil: onlar yalnızca sesle sürer.
settings_background_hint.de: Der Ton läuft weiter, wenn Sie die App verlassen oder den Bildschirm sperren. Bild-in-Bild startet, wenn Sie die App während eines Videos verlassen – nicht bei Streams mit der VLC-Engine (MKV, TS, …): Diese laufen nur mit Ton weiter.
